title: Insect cell culture in reagent bottles
author: Rieffel, Roest, et al.

steps.title: Prepare bottles for sterilization
steps.instruction: Remove caps from reagent bottles (Cat. no. 100389, VITLAB) delivered non‑sterile and cover each bottle opening with aluminum foil.

steps.title: Place BOLA caps in sterilization container
steps.instruction: Place BOLA screw‑caps (Article No. H 999-45, Bola) into a sterilizing bag or other suitable container.

steps.title: Autoclave bottles and caps
steps.instruction: Sterilize the bottles and caps by autoclaving at 121 °C, 15 psi for 15 min.

steps.title: Replace foil with caps and tape
steps.instruction: Under a laminar‑flow hood, remove the aluminum foil, fit BOLA caps onto the bottles, and cover the cap openings with AirPore tape sheet (Cat. no. 19571, Qiagen).

steps.title: Alternative: use AirPore tape only
steps.instruction: If preferred, apply AirPore tape directly to the bottle opening instead of using BOLA caps; note that BOLA caps make sampling during culture easier.

steps.title: Alternative: sterilize with caps loosely on
steps.instruction: Optionally, place loosened BOLA caps on the bottles, cover with aluminum foil, autoclave as above, then replace the foil with AirPore tape after sterilization.
